name: EU Capital Gain 2 Code
definition: Specifies whether capital gain is in the scope of the European directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments (Council Directive 2003/48/EC 3 June) for an income realised upon sale, a refund or redemption of shares and units etc.

EUSI.name: Capital Gain In Scope
EUSI.definition: Capital gain is in the scope of the directive.

EUSO.name: Capital Gain Out Scope
EUSO.definition: Capital gain is out of the scope of the directive.

UKWN.name: Capital Gain Unknown
UKWN.definition: Unknown whether capital gain is in or out of the scope of the directive.
